subject: Post-discovery: plan the 30-min product show-and-tell
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@ceresys.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: plan the 30-min product show-and-tell

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Ceresys is focused on lowering inference cost for higher-concurrency customer-facing flows and needs predictable latency for sub-200ms p95 on short prompts. You indicated the primary evaluation criteria will be (1) latency consistency, (2) operational observability, and (3) ease of integration with your existing infra.

Next step: we'd love to run a focused 30-minute show-and-tell that covers the runtime architecture, a short demo of end-to-end inference (including routing/fallback), and a short Q&A with your infra lead. Can you confirm which of the following 30-minute windows works for your team? I included times in PT.

- Tue May 19 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed May 20 — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu May 21 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Also: who from Ceresys should join that 30-min session? Based on today's discussion, I think Maya (CTO) and your infra owner would be valuable to include. If procurement needs to be looped for any contractual questions we can pull them into a later sync.

I attached a short one-pager with the items we'll demo and a pre-demo checklist for infra requests. If you prefer a different cadence (longer technical deep dive after the show-and-tell), we can plan that as a follow-up.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf, pre-demo-tech-checklist.md
From: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@ceresys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@ceresys.com>, Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@ceresys.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: plan the 30-min product show-and-tell

Mina — thanks for the recap and the one-pager. Appreciated.

The Wed May 20 slot at 14:00 PT works best for us. Maya (CTO) will join, and I've asked Samuel (infra) to attend the show-and-tell as the technical point of contact. Procurement won't need to be on this initial session but may join the next meeting if we move fast.

Two quick asks up front:
1) Can you share a short list of observability screenshots (latency, token-level cost breakdown) in advance so Samuel can scope prerequisites?
2) If you can call out any network/IP allowlists we need ahead of time, that'll speed the setup.

I'll accept the calendar invite once you send it.

Thanks,
Alex Duarte
Head of Platform Engineering | Ceresys
alex.duarte@ceresys.com

On Sun, May 17, 2026 at 3:12 PM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery...
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@ceresys.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: plan the 30-min product show-and-tell

Hi Alex — thanks, Wed 14:00 PT is on our side and I've tentatively blocked the time on our calendar. Mina — I'll send the formal invite with a short agenda and an event link.

Alex — per your asks, attaching two quick items: the observability screenshots deck (token-level cost + p50/p95 traces) and a short note on network allowlist entries you may need for the session. Summary below:

- Observability: sample dashboard shows per-route latency histogram, per-token cost waterfall, and a short trace for a 128-token prompt (we'll share actual metrics once we run a quick load test).
- Network: allowlist outbound to service.redwood-inference.com (TCP 443) and optional gRPC endpoints (service-grpc.redwood-inference.com). We'll provide IP ranges if you prefer a fixed CIDR.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
1) 0–6m — intros & success criteria
2) 6–16m — live end-to-end demo (routing + fallback behavior)
3) 16–24m — observability walk-through (latency/cost dashboards)
4) 24–30m — quick Q&A & next steps (technical deep dive or procurement touchpoint)

I'll attach the files to the invite: redwood-onepager.pdf and pre-demo-tech-checklist.md so Samuel can review.

If you want a longer deep-dive later we can carve out an hour and Priyom (me) will bring an engineer for the kernel/runtime questions.

See you Wed — Priyom
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: observability-screenshots.pdf, network-allowlist-note.txt
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@ceresys.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: plan the 30-min product show-and-tell

Alex / team — quick note from my side: thanks for locking Wed 14:00 PT. Mina — I'll run the invite and take the lead on notes and follow-up action items. Priyom — you'll present the runtime demo, Mina you'll take the product/ROI narrative.

Alex — if Maya or Samuel want to share any specific prompts or traces you'd like us to demo (an example user flow), drop them here or upload to the shared Drive link in the invite. We'll keep the session tightly scoped so we can surface next-steps (pilot vs. evaluation checklist).

Looking forward,
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
